note: Generated by npm run catalogue:build from data/sources/combo-sources.json; edit that file, not this one. Skill XP is given per block broken, not per item (wiki Farming note; the Mining and Foraging tables are per block too), so XP per item = XP per block / (base items per block x (1 + fortune/100)). Fortune per bracket matches the collection rate brackets in rate-defaults.json. Base drops are 1 unless listed; the wiki pages don't state them, so listed ones are vanilla or community values and say so. Items with no XP on these tables (Hard Stone, Umber, Tungsten, Glacite, Sulphur, Mycelium, Red Sand, fishing and mob drops) get no gathering combo.
